if blue_line_time_ratio > 0.4: position = D else: position = F. F with faceoff = C, left_bias = LW, right_bias = RW
track which 3 forwards always enter/exit ice together = same line. identify 1 -> get all 3
height = head_to_foot via homography. shoulder_width = shoulder_left to right. ratio = upper/lower body
split bbox into 5 zones (helmet/shoulder/gloves/pants/socks). extract color histogram per zone. build per-player profile at game start
10-frame pose keypoint sequences -> 170d vector. contrastive learning: same track = positive, diff track = negative. no labels needed

target: 99.5% even when jersey OCR fails completely
